name: PJ Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: PJ Electronics Co., Ltd., headquartered in Bucheon-si, South Korea, specializes in providing comprehensive electronic manufacturing services. The company supplies components and assemblies across a diverse range of high-tech sectors, including medical devices, automotive electronics, robot controllers, and various IT products, offering both flexible and traditional printed circuit board (PCB) assembly solutions. Their advanced manufacturing operations are underpinned by an extensive array of production machinery. This includes cutting-edge printers, dispensers, high-speed and multi-mounters, routers, robotic screw systems, N2 reflow ovens, and specialized soldering, under-fill, coating, press-fit, ultrasonic cleaning, and washing equipment. Quality assurance is maintained through a robust suite of inspection tools such as temperature/humidity chambers, 3D coordinate measurement machines, magnifiers, automated optical inspection (AOI) systems, solder paste and coating inspection machines, X-ray/CT scanners, and various electrical testers, including in-circuit, functional, flying probe, and XRF testers. Beyond manufacturing, PJ Electronics provides vital engineering support for new product development. This encompasses designing printed circuit boards and function test fixtures, optimizing production processes for greater efficiency, offering design for manufacturing/assembly (DfM/DfA) insights, and ensuring signal and power integrity. Originally established in 1969 as PJ Industry Co., Ltd., the company adopted its current name, PJ Electronics Co., Ltd., in February 2000.
